row.body: The pump key is signed back before the last fuel delivery, and a note asks the crew to keep the drum sealed until the next test.
row.title: The pump key was returned

sidecar.gloss: A fuel delivery follows a key return and a request to keep the drum sealed.
sidecar.rival_reading: A response team could seal fuel during an emergency; the note does not say what the test was meant to find.

row.body: oily field residue links the short rope and water bottle. a clean waterline shows both were rinsed before the road closed.
row.title: field residue on the short rope

sidecar.gloss: A rare everyday object carries residue tied to field work before restriction.
sidecar.rival_reading: Emergency workers crossing treated land could have picked up the same residue; the objects do not prove the farm program began the emergency.
